description: Land Acquisition - Methagama, Kotmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing a parcel of land to be acquired for village widening purposes. It includes details about the land location, extent, lot number, and compensation claims process, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
